subject: Admit Unified Journal and Journal Archive as mandatory FA3 GUI infrastructure
rationale: FA3 needs a single operational history for system events, conversations, project lifecycle, evidence and audit context.
Closed and aged journal data requires deterministic retention, integrity verification and restorable archives rather than unstructured log deletion.
The FA3 Control Center is the correct native GUI projection surface and must not create a new canonical, evidence, resource or execution authority.
